# Generated by eu5autobuild.governor_generator.
# Proximity uses the vanilla 0-100 scale. Control and Maximum Control use 0-1.
# Control is a downstream value: Proximity is the main input to Max Control,
# while integration, satisfaction, armies, and buildings can also modify it.
# The recommendation score therefore does not invent a Control multiplier.

eu5ab_governor_potential_tax_base = {
	# Current tax base scales with current control, not its future maximum.
	# At zero control, wealth cannot be recovered from the current tax base.
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { local_control > 0 }
		value = location_tax_base
		divide = local_control
	}
}

# A compact value model avoids counting correlated size metrics at full weight.
# 1 = mixed, 2 = economic, 3 = administrative population.
eu5ab_governor_location_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 2 }
		value = { value = eu5ab_governor_potential_tax_base multiply = 2.5 }
		add = { value = population multiply = 0.15 }
		add = { value = development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 3 }
		value = { value = eu5ab_governor_potential_tax_base multiply = 0.25 }
		add = { value = population multiply = 1.2 }
		add = { value = development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	else = {
		value = { value = eu5ab_governor_potential_tax_base multiply = 1.5 }
		add = { value = population multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_strategic_value > 0 }
		if = { limit = { is_port = yes } multiply = 1.15 }
		if = { limit = { has_fort = yes } multiply = 1.1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_neighbor_location = {
					has_owner = yes
					NOT = { owner ?= prev.owner }
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.1
		}
	}
	min = 0.01
}

eu5ab_governor_node_marginal_gain = {
	value = var:eu5ab_gov_predicted
	subtract = eu5ab_governor_comparison_proximity
	min = 0
	divide = 100
	multiply = var:eu5ab_gov_node_value
}


# Country scope. Unlocks, not the roads already built, define the planning tier.
eu5ab_governor_highest_road_tier = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_advance = railroad_advance } value = 4 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_advance = modern_road_advance } value = 3 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_advance = paved_road_advance } value = 2 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_advance = road_building } value = 1 }
}

eu5ab_governor_topography_penalty = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { topography = mountains } value = -0.5 }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = hills } value = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = plateau } value = -0.125 }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = wetlands } value = -0.25 }
}
eu5ab_governor_topography_impact = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { topography = mountains } value = owner.modifier:mountains_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = hills } value = owner.modifier:hills_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = plateau } value = owner.modifier:plateau_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = wetlands } value = owner.modifier:wetlands_proximity_impact }
}
eu5ab_governor_vegetation_penalty = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { vegetation = desert } value = -0.05 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = farmland } value = -0.05 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = woods } value = -0.125 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = forest } value = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = jungle } value = -0.5 }
}
eu5ab_governor_transport_speed = {
    value = 1
    add = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_global_speed
    add = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_land_speed
    add = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_local_speed
    min = 0.05
}
eu5ab_governor_transport_topography = {
    value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_topography
    multiply = { value = 1 add = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_topography_impact }
    max = 0
}
eu5ab_governor_edge_cost_factor = {
    value = 1
    divide = eu5ab_governor_transport_speed
    divide = { value = 1 add = eu5ab_governor_transport_topography min = 0.5 }
}
eu5ab_governor_road_edge_base_cost = {
    value = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_road_base
    multiply = eu5ab_governor_edge_cost_factor
}
eu5ab_governor_planned_road_cost = {
    value = var:eu5ab_gov_road_edge_base_cost
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_gov_transport_road_tier
        subtract = 1
        multiply = 5
        multiply = var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor
    }
    min = { value = 0.01 multiply = var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
}
eu5ab_governor_land_edge_base_cost = {
    value = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_land_base
    min = 0.01
    divide = eu5ab_governor_transport_speed
    divide = {
        value = 1
        add = eu5ab_governor_transport_topography
        add = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_vegetation
        min = 0.5
    }
}

# Naval straits keep their actual connection, without a hypothetical road.
eu5ab_governor_land_edge_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                root.var:eu5ab_gov_transport_road_tier > 0
                NOT = { eu5ab_is_strait_connection_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from } }
            }
            value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_planned_road_cost
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_road_to = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from }
            value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_road_edge_base_cost
            if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:railroad } }
                subtract = { value = 15 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:modern_road } }
                subtract = { value = 10 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:paved_road } }
                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

# Called after the neighbor filter has excluded straits.
eu5ab_governor_known_land_edge_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                root.var:eu5ab_gov_transport_road_tier > 0
            }
            value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_planned_road_cost

        else_if = {
            limit = { has_road_to = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from }
            value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_road_edge_base_cost
            if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:railroad } }
                subtract = { value = 15 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:modern_road } }
                subtract = { value = 10 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:paved_road } }
                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

# Actual connections only: the caller has already selected the road mode.
eu5ab_governor_actual_land_edge_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_road_to = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from }
            value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_road_edge_base_cost
            if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:railroad } }
                subtract = { value = 15 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:modern_road } }
                subtract = { value = 10 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from type = road_type:paved_road } }
                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

# Contract a known lake transit into two directed edges. Lake local speed is
# zero; entering uses the land source's local modifier. Never mutate a lake.
eu5ab_governor_lake_transit_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_lake_base
        divide = {
            value = 1 add = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_global_speed
            add = scope:eu5ab_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_local_speed
            min = 0.05
        }
    }
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_lake_base
        divide = { value = 1 add = root.var:eu5ab_gov_cached_global_speed min = 0.05 }
    }
    min = 0
}

eu5ab_governor_comparison_proximity = {
    value = var:eu5ab_gov_planned_proximity
}


# Preserve the raw additive source, including the capital and temporary effects.
# Subtract only the moving seat's 80 points BEFORE clamping propagation to 0-100.
eu5ab_governor_current_proximity_source = {
	value = modifier:local_proximity_source
}

# Vanilla 1.4: registered AND enabled DLC makes Lieutenancies independent.
# Unregistered DLC must not be referenced: has_dlc fails during post-validation.
eu5ab_governor_local_other_slots = {
	value = total_building_levels_including_construction:itinerant_court_seat
	add = total_building_levels_including_construction:kings_manor
	if = { limit = { always = yes }
		add = total_building_levels_including_construction:lieutenancy
	}
}
eu5ab_governor_fresh_local_other_slots = {
	value = var:eu5ab_gov_fresh_itinerant_seats
	add = var:eu5ab_gov_fresh_kings_manors
	if = { limit = { always = yes }
		add = var:eu5ab_gov_fresh_lieutenancies
	}
}

eu5ab_governor_refresh_months = {
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 1 } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 3 } value = 6 }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 4 } value = 12 }
	else = { value = 3 }
}

# Cap unused-slot alerts so national growth cannot suppress useful local sites.
eu5ab_governor_new_recommendation_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_governor_total_value
	multiply = 0.01
	min = 1
	max = 1000
}

# Keep the existing full-layout selection policy independent of alert tuning.
eu5ab_governor_layout_candidate_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_governor_total_value
	multiply = 0.01
	min = 1
}

eu5ab_governor_migration_absolute_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_governor_total_value
	multiply = 0.02
	min = 2
}

eu5ab_governor_relocation_capacity = {
    value = var:eu5ab_gov_fresh_local_capacity
    subtract = eu5ab_governor_fresh_local_other_slots
}
eu5ab_governor_relocation_occupied = {
    value = var:eu5ab_gov_fresh_local_occupied
}

eu5ab_governor_cached_location_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 2 }
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 2.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_population multiply = 0.15 }

		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 3 }
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 0.25 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_population multiply = 1.2 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	else = {
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 1.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_population multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_gov_cached_development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_strategic_value > 0 }

					has_owner = yes
					NOT = { owner ?= prev.owner }
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.1
		}
	}
	min = 0.01
}

	# Current tax base scales with current control, not its future maximum.
	# At zero control, wealth cannot be recovered from the current tax base.
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { local_control > 0 }
		value = location_tax_base
		divide = local_control
	}
}

		add = { value = population multiply = 0.15 }
		add = { value = development multiply = 0.75 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 3 }

		add = { value = development multiply = 0.75 }

    else_if = { limit = { has_advance = paved_road_advance } value = 2 }

    else_if = { limit = { topography = hills } value = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = plateau } value = -0.125 }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = wetlands } value = -0.25 }
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_topography_impact = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { topography = mountains } value = owner.modifier:mountains_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = hills } value = owner.modifier:hills_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = plateau } value = owner.modifier:plateau_proximity_impact }
    else_if = { limit = { topography = wetlands } value = owner.modifier:wetlands_proximity_impact }

    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = woods } value = -0.125 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = forest } value = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { vegetation = jungle } value = -0.5 }

eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_speed = {
    value = 1
    add = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_global_speed
    add = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_land_speed
    add = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_local_speed
    min = 0.05
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_topography = {
    value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_topography
    multiply = { value = 1 add = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_topography_impact }
    max = 0
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_edge_cost_factor = {
    value = 1
    divide = eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_speed
    divide = { value = 1 add = eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_topography min = 0.5 }
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_road_edge_base_cost = {
    value = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_road_base
    multiply = eu5ab_naval_planner_edge_cost_factor
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_planned_road_cost = {
    value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_road_edge_base_cost
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_transport_road_tier
        subtract = 1
        multiply = 5
        multiply = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor
    }
    min = { value = 0.01 multiply = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_land_edge_base_cost = {
    value = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_land_base
    min = 0.01
    divide = eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_speed
    divide = {
        value = 1
        add = eu5ab_naval_planner_transport_topography
        add = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_vegetation
        min = 0.5
    }
}

# Naval straits keep their actual connection, without a hypothetical road.
eu5ab_naval_planner_land_edge_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_transport_road_tier > 0
                NOT = { eu5ab_is_strait_connection_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from } }
            }
            value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_planned_road_cost
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_road_to = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from }
            value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_road_edge_base_cost
            if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:railroad } }
                subtract = { value = 15 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:modern_road } }
                subtract = { value = 10 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:paved_road } }
                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

# Actual connections only: the caller has already selected the road mode.
eu5ab_naval_planner_actual_land_edge_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_road_to = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from }
            value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_road_edge_base_cost
            if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:railroad } }
                subtract = { value = 15 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:modern_road } }
                subtract = { value = 10 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from type = road_type:paved_road } }
                subtract = { value = 5 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
            }
            min = { value = 0.01 multiply = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_cost_factor }
        }
        else = { value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_land_edge_base_cost }
    }
    min = 0
}

# Contract a known lake transit into two directed edges. Lake local speed is
# zero; entering uses the land source's local modifier. Never mutate a lake.
eu5ab_naval_planner_lake_transit_prediction = {
    value = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_predicted
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_lake_base
        divide = {
            value = 1 add = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_global_speed
            add = scope:eu5ab_naval_gov_edge_from.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_local_speed
            min = 0.05
        }
    }
    subtract = {
        value = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_lake_base
        divide = { value = 1 add = root.var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_global_speed min = 0.05 }
    }
    min = 0
}

eu5ab_naval_planner_comparison_proximity = {
    value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_planned_proximity
}


# Preserve the raw additive source, including the capital and temporary effects.
# Subtract only the moving seat's 80 points BEFORE clamping propagation to 0-100.
eu5ab_naval_planner_current_proximity_source = {
	value = modifier:local_proximity_source
}

# Vanilla 1.4: registered AND enabled DLC makes Lieutenancies independent.
# Unregistered DLC must not be referenced: has_dlc fails during post-validation.



eu5ab_naval_planner_refresh_months = {
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 1 } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 3 } value = 6 }
	else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_governor_refresh_interval = 4 } value = 12 }
	else = { value = 3 }
}

# Cap unused-slot alerts so national growth cannot suppress useful local sites.
eu5ab_naval_planner_new_recommendation_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_naval_planner_total_value
	multiply = 0.01
	min = 1
	max = 1000
}

# Keep the existing full-layout selection policy independent of alert tuning.
eu5ab_naval_planner_layout_candidate_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_naval_planner_total_value
	multiply = 0.01
	min = 1
}

eu5ab_naval_planner_migration_absolute_threshold = {
	value = var:eu5ab_naval_planner_total_value
	multiply = 0.02
	min = 2
}

eu5ab_naval_planner_relocation_capacity = {
    value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_fresh_naval_capacity
}
eu5ab_naval_planner_relocation_occupied = {
    value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_fresh_naval_occupied
}

eu5ab_naval_planner_cached_location_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 2 }
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 2.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_population multiply = 0.15 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_scoring_profile = 3 }
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 0.25 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_population multiply = 1.2 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	else = {
		value = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_potential_tax_base multiply = 1.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_population multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = var:eu5ab_naval_gov_cached_development multiply = 0.75 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_governor_strategic_value > 0 }
		if = { limit = { is_port = yes } multiply = 1.15 }
		if = { limit = { has_fort = yes } multiply = 1.1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_neighbor_location = {
					has_owner = yes
					NOT = { owner ?= prev.owner }
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.1
		}
	}
	min = 0.01
}
